methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: We attempt to do so by adding the variable of monitoring to the MOA model.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: The paper tests an organisational-behaviour MOA framework; energy-performance monitoring is only a construct, with no identifiable EnPI or EnB measurement model.

paper_type.evidence_quote: We tested this novel framework using data from an industry survey conducted by the Energy Studies Institute, National University of Singapore.

stage1.notes: Industrial survey across several sectors; it models adoption outcomes and barriers, not organisational energy use or a normalised energy baseline.
